summary: Ubuntu 19.04 (Disco Dingo) was released on 18 April 2019. Features: GNOME 3.32, Python 3.7, Mesa 19.0. The dingo is an Australian wild dog; 'disco' evoked a fun, vibrant release. Interim focus on desktop refinement and developer tooling.
notes: Unsupported since 2020-01-23. Kernel 5.0. Standard 9-month interim support.
